messages:
Nina Park: Postmortem up for the weekend vendor auth outage: https://rwd.co/pm/2635-auth-vendor. Summary: provider maintenance + token rate-limits caused cascading failures in model-registry auth. PM lists four action tracks: 1) short-term token TTL + prefetch, 2) implement soft local cache + CB, 3) add multi-region synthetic + alerting, 4) update runbooks + escalation. Need owners + concrete ETAs by EOD so we can publish the remediation plan to exec.

Owen Li: I'll take (1) TTL + prefetch. Plan: bump cached token TTL from 12s -> 40s, add prefetch at T-10s, add introspect check before accepting longer TTL. ETA: PR 2026-03-25, rollout 2026-03-29 behind feature-flag. Risk: provider may reject introspect calls under load; will coordinate with Diego (monitoring).

Fatima Khan: I'll own (2) soft cache + circuit-breaker in the model-registry client. Proposal: add in-memory LRU token cache with TTL override, CB triggers when provider 5xx rate > 6% sustained 20s. PR with unit + integration tests by 2026-03-27, staged rollout 2026-04-05. Risk: increased memory usage on high-throughput workers; plan to cap entries per worker.

Jon Peters: I'll do (3) synthetic checks and alerts. Adding a regional synthetic that hits token endpoint every 30s from US/EU/APAC and alert rules: severity-2 if 3 failures in 5m per region, severity-1 if 5xx rate > 7% for 2m. ETA: synthetic + dashboards 2026-03-24, alert rules 2026-03-25. Also opening vendor SLA thread to request concrete rate-limit and RTO commitments.

ops-bot: Created tasks: RWD-9175 (ttl-prefetch) -> Owen Li; RWD-9176 (local-token-cache-cb) -> Fatima Khan; RWD-9177 (synthetic-token-monitoring) -> Jon Peters. Links: https://jira.rwd/browse/RWD-9175 .../9177

Nina Park: Cross-cutting Qs: (A) do we want a token-broker service long-term? (B) should we standardize SDK backoff + jitter default?

Owen Li: Broker adds operational overhead; prefer local cache + CB + improve vendor SLA first.

Fatima Khan: Agree on SDK backoff standardization. I'll draft a small change: default jittered exponential backoff (base=120ms, maxRetries=6). Target SDK minor release 2026-03-31.

Jon Peters: Note: if synthetic detects repeat patterns over 3 incidents in 90 days, recommend a resilience retro to evaluate multi-provider. I'll start a 90-day pattern detection ticket and link it in the PM.

Nina Park: Please add your ETA + 1-line risk to the PM doc now. Scheduling a 15m check-in Mon 10:30 to confirm progress. If any owner needs help, post blockers here before EOD.

Owen Li: Added ETA + risk to PM. Potential blocker: legal approval for token-introspection in prod; will flag by EOD if delayed.

Fatima Khan: Added notes. Potential blocker: increased memory caps might require infra approval for worker sizing; will escalate if needed.

Jon Peters: Added vendor SLA request and alert thresholds. Starting SLA procurement thread.

Nina Park: Thanks 44D. ops-bot, please create epic RWD-9180 and link tasks. We'll publish the remediation plan after the Monday sync.
